verdict.rationale: Sketch's first-party prototyping docs show designers can create links and Hotspots between frames, trigger Overlays, and use hover, press and toggle triggers. This is all done in the Mac app with no code, and prototypes can be played on real devices. Transitions (animation types between screens) are never documented in the evidence, and no independent or hands-on reports confirm the prototyping workflow, so full coverage is not established. missing for 10: documented transition/animation options between screens, independent or hands-on corroboration of the prototyping workflow.

support.subject: As a designer, I can wire screens into clickable prototypes with triggers, transitions, and overlays — no code required
